name: Joska
description: A pristine moon where Celestial Palatinate colonists were massacred, breaking the negotiated peace.

timeline.summary: In memory, Reen recalls Joska and the Palatinate lander that her squad targeted.
timeline.quote: If she keeps her eyes shut, she sees, inevitably, the target: a Palatinate lander bobbing just offshore.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | Compact Me to Zero
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Compact Me to Zero" by Rich Larson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Too Much Happiness connects Reen's tattoos to the Joska atrocity that ended the peace.
timeline.quote: The atrocity that ended the negotiated peace occurred on the moon called Joska.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | Compact Me to Zero
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Compact Me to Zero" by Rich Larson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Celestial Palatinate colonists are massacred on Joska, breaking the negotiated peace in the Entropy War.
timeline.quote: After three hundred Celestial Palatinate colonists were massacred here, the negotiated peace in the Entropy War was broken.

citation.text: "Edge", section "Astrography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

pages_say.description: A moon with violet seas where Reen's squad destroyed a Palatinate lander of three hundred colonists, the atrocity that ended the negotiated peace.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | Compact Me to Zero
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Compact Me to Zero" by Rich Larson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.
